title: Nav item viewName generates a short-name route that silently falls back to the default view
body:
## Symptom

An app nav item with `viewName: 'tabular'` navigates to `/apps/<app>/<object>/view/tabular`, but the page renders the **default view** (first view), not the tabular view. Manually visiting the fully-qualified URL `/view/<object>.tabular` works. No warning is emitted — the fallback is completely silent, so the misconfiguration is invisible.

Found while dogfooding `app-showcase` (framework repo): Analytics app → "Task List" nav item → renders the default grid instead of the `showcase_task.tabular` view.

## Root cause (verified against source)

Canonical view ids are **fully qualified** (`<object>.<viewKind>`):

- `packages/app-shell/src/providers/MetadataProvider.tsx:164-174` — canonical key = `view.name || \`${view.object}.${view.viewKind}\``; the comment explicitly says `/view/<name>` URLs resolve directly against switcher tab ids.

But the nav-link generators emit the **short name verbatim**:

- `packages/layout/src/NavigationRenderer.tsx:401` — `href: item.viewName ? \`${objectPath}/view/${item.viewName}\` : objectPath`
- `packages/layout/src/AppSchemaRenderer.tsx:~216` (mobile bottom nav) — `if (item.viewName) href += \`/view/${item.viewName}\`;`

And the resolver does an exact-id lookup with a **silent** fallback:

- `packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.tsx:660-661`
  ```ts
  const activeViewId = viewId || searchParams.get('view') || defaultViewId || views[0]?.id;
  const baseView = views.find((v: any) => v.id === activeViewId) || views[0];
  ```
  A short name never matches a fully-qualified id → `|| views[0]` silently swallows it.

In-page tab switching is unaffected because `handleViewChange` (`ObjectView.tsx:675-690`) navigates with `matchedView.id` (already qualified).

## Fix

Make the resolver in `ObjectView.tsx` robust in both directions:

1. exact match first;
2. short name (no `.`) → retry as `\`${objectName}.${name}\`` (covers nav-generated short links);
3. qualified name → retry with the `\`${objectName}.\`` prefix stripped (covers legacy embedded listViews whose keys are bare, incl. the `'all'` fallback view);
4. if still unmatched, `console.warn` listing known view ids before falling back — no more silent swallowing.

Same treatment for the `?view=` search param.
